items.title: Thieves steal Nvidia-labeled trailers expecting massive AI GPU payday, but score 40,000 pounds of sand instead
items.summary: The two PlusAI trailers with Nvidia-partner markings were apparently left outside the startup's warehouse, making it a juicy target for criminals looking to make easy money on AI GPUs. However, they were deliberately left outside as the trailers only contained sand for simulating real-world truck loads.
items.title_original: Thieves steal Nvidia-labeled trailers expecting massive AI GPU payday, but score 40,000 pounds of sand instead
items.title_en: Thieves steal Nvidia-labeled trailers expecting massive AI GPU payday, but score 40,000 pounds of sand instead
items.title_bilingual: Thieves steal Nvidia-labeled trailers expecting massive AI GPU payday, but score 40,000 pounds of sand instead
items.summary_zh: 两辆带有 Nvidia 合作伙伴标记的 PlusAI 拖车显然被留在了这家初创公司的仓库外，这使其成为那些希望通过 AI GPU 轻松赚钱的犯罪分子的目标。然而，它们被故意留在外面，因为拖车只装有沙子来模拟现实世界的卡车负载。

items.title: Linux enthusiasts see 10-second kernel compilation times on the horizon
items.summary: It won’t be long until Linux enthusiasts will be able to complete a clean kernel build in under 10 seconds thanks to advances in PC hardware and the AI-assisted optimization of compilers.
